name: throw_trash
text: A person stands in front of a waist-high litter bin, leans forward slightly and reaches the right hand toward the front opening to toss an empty paper coffee cup inside, then draws the right hand back. Left hand stays by the side. Keep feet planted.

review.reason: 向垃圾桶开口伸右手并收回；3帧全身约束，手的接触目标误差3.3厘米，无冻结；杯子释放与飞行由接入方控制。
review.known_limitations: SOMA77 单人源动作；未做运行时火柴人映射与场景接触验收。手指无独立抓取动画。
review.post_export_edits: 仅walk_brisk裁剪记录中的完整周期；其余NPZ保持生成输出原样。
review.constraint_source_note: 临时参考路径仅为来源记录；实际约束数值保存在constraint_targets。
